text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Baku-chan, pass!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Gwaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Ngh, the timing might be slightly off. 
Shall we try slowing down the tempo of the 
passes a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "*pant*... *gasp*... G-Guhhh..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"No! All that is required is for me to run 
faster and further forward! 
Laurel-san, one more time, please!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek... *pant*... J-Just one more 
time..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I have detected severe 'fatigue' from 
Tannhauser-san. 
How about we 'take a short breather'?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... f-fine... I have to be able to 
catch... even faster balls... 
normally...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, please make sure to stay 
hydrated. 
If anyone needs taping, please let me 
know."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, we're getting closer to the 
ideal form we're aiming for. 
Let's not rush, and firmly solidify our 
foundation."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to explain once again. 
The 'Special Move' we are striving for 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An assured attack executed from an 
'uncontested position.'

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"? So that means... basically... what does 
that mean?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"For example, Tannhauser-san, with her 
tenacious catching, secures the ball. 
Bourbon-san and Laurel-san then connect it 
through reliable pass work."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"While this is our standard formation, 
the issue at hand is our current lack of a 
decisive finishing blow."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Thus, I devised an 'attack from the blind 
spot.' No matter how strong an opposing 
team is, 
they cannot maintain 360-degree vigilance 
amidst a scramble. In such a moment—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"As long as we identify the opponent's 
blind spot, Bakushin O-san can 
reliably rack up points with her unrivaled 
speed."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oho, so you desire the power of the Class 
Rep at the climax! 
Leave it to me! I shall Bakushin to the 
absolute best position!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If realized, it will become a weapon 
worthy of being called a 'Special Move.' 
To that end, we must first reinforce our 
formation."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—In the meantime, I intend to seek out a 
method for capturing the opponent's blind 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
".........Phew. 
Hehe, when I first heard 'Special Move,' I 
wondered how it would turn out, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know why, but I really feel like 
this will work. 
Because I can tell everyone is united 
toward the very same goal..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, I believe our path is nearly 
visible now. 
All that remains is truly the final 
piece... if only we have one decisive 
factor..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"(A place free from interference... 
unguardable, yet easy for us to aim at. 
It must exist somewhere. A location that 
naturally creates a psychological blind 
spot—)"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah, Ikuno, I'm sorry! 
It slipped! The ball is heading your—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(So bright...! The sunlight, it's right 
in...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"(Ah...! 
I see... with this, surely—!)"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry for the wait! I've gathered players 
for the opposing team. 
So, what is it that you'd like to try, 
Ikuno-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"First, please move as if this were an 
actual match. 
I will give instructions along the way—let 
us begin!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"The opponent's attack is~ caught with 
elbows tucked in! 
And then~~, Laurel-san, pass!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Understood! Next, Bourbon-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me—Ikuno-san!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Right here! Here it comes, Bakushin 
O-san! 
If it's you, I know you can catch this 
pass—!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Nuooo!? A wild throw!?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "No, continue straight upward—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Upward! Meaning I should jump, right! 
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Toryaaa! BAKUSHIN ATTACK—!!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Amazing, amazing, amazing! What was that 
just now!?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I have finally found it... This is the 
final piece."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"By throwing from a high elevation, we 
exploit the opponent's psychological blind 
spot, 
enabling a pinpoint attack from an 
advantageous position—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"That means our 'Special Move' is 
complete, right!? I mean, that was 
incredible! 
The pass moved all whoosh-whoosh-whoosh, 
like tracing a star!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"And the finish had the impact of a meteor 
crashing down with a massive KABOOM! 
Now THAT really feels like a 'Special 
Move'—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Falling Meteor. It certainly 
possesses the ring of a 'Special Move.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally complete... our 'Special 
Move.' 
With this, we can definitely win the Fan 
Thanksgiving!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Let us do this, everyone! We shall 
perform a grand Bakushin with this 
'Special Move' 
and unquestionably stand atop that stage 
reserved for champions!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Let us demonstrate the fruits of our 
practice to our hearts' content."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(With this team, I know we can reach it... 
That beautiful view beyond all hardships, 
one we have yet to see—)
